description:
Trinetix is looking for a C++ Developer with strong Qt/QML skills to help build desktop image-processing applications for Mac and Windows, and to help move parts of them to the cloud. 
You will join an established remote team that works autonomously and treats AI as a core part of the job. If you want to see what modern C++ and AI-first development can achieve together, let’s talk. 

Responsibilities 

  • Develop and maintain features of desktop applications in C++ and Qt/QML for Windows and macOS. 
  • Build responsive, consistent and user-friendly interfaces in QML. 
  • Own features end to end: clarify requirements, estimate, implement, review and test. 
  • Contribute to moving selected desktop functionality to cloud-based services. 
  • Write and maintain automated tests, and help with manual testing when needed. 
  • Investigate and fix defects, including platform-specific issues. 
  • Work with the team in Jira, Confluence and GitHub: plan tasks, document solutions and review pull requests. 

Requirements 

  • 2+ years of commercial experience building GUI applications with Qt. 
  • Solid knowledge of modern C++. 
  • Hands-on experience with QML. 
  • Experience shipping desktop software for both Windows and macOS. 
  • Good understanding of UI/UX principles. 
  • Experience with automated testing and CI pipelines. 
  • Confident use of Git/GitHub and Jira/Confluence. 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a self-organized remote team. 
  • Fluent Ukrainian (the team’s working language). 
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher. 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience orchestrating multiple AI agents or building agent-based development workflows. 
  • Experience with image processing, graphics or photo-editing software. 
  • Familiarity with Adobe Lightroom or Photoshop, including plug-in development. 
  • Experience optimizing desktop application performance (multithreading, memory usage, rendering). 

What we offer   

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities 
  • Professional training and English/Spanish language classes   
  • Comprehensive medical insurance 
  • Mental health support 
  • Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more 
  • Flexible working hours 
  • Inclusive and supportive culture 

About Us 

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world. 

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture. 

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics.
